description: Agro Processors & Atmospheric Gases Ltd. is a Pakistani edible-oil company that has sold cooking oil and banaspati since 1981 under brands including Soya Supreme and Malta. It began as a family concern founded by three brothers who migrated to Pakistan in 1947, and the company describes itself today as one of the country's leading edible-oil businesses.
